updates.businessProblem: Small teams can miss inbound customer calls while staff are busy or unavailable. When callers cannot leave a clear request, contact details, or preferred next step, the team has less information to use when following up.
updates.solution: Merxus AI answers inbound calls, captures caller intent and contact details, and supports appointment requests and configured follow-up workflows. Teams can use it to handle first-line call intake while keeping people responsible for reviewing and acting on requests.
keyFeatures: Answers inbound calls and captures the caller’s request and contact details.
Supports appointment requests and routes captured information into business workflows.
Can send configured service notifications, including voice or SMS follow-up where applicable and consented.
Provides business use-case information and messaging disclosures on the public product site.
technicalCapabilities: AI-assisted voice workflows for inbound call handling and structured request capture.
Voice and SMS communication paths for configured service follow-up.
Consent-aware messaging behavior and customer communication controls.
developmentChallenges: Capture useful caller intent and contact information during a natural phone conversation.
Connect call handling to practical appointment and follow-up workflows.
Represent communication and consent limits clearly in product behavior and public disclosures.
outcomes: A live product for inbound call answering and customer request capture.
A public website that explains supported workflows, use cases, and messaging disclosures.
updates.seoTitle: Merxus AI Receptionist Case Study | Workside Software
updates.metaDescription: How Workside developed Merxus AI for inbound call answering, customer request capture, appointment requests, and configured follow-up workflows.

updates.businessProblem: People need workout plans they can adapt to their goals and schedule, along with a simple way to follow daily sessions and review progress over time.
updates.solution: SageSet is an iPhone fitness app for creating or generating editable workout plans, following daily sessions, and recording progress. Its published app also includes guided squat challenges with camera-based repetition tracking.
keyFeatures: Personalized workout plans, including optional AI-assisted plan generation.
Daily exercise instructions with sets, repetitions, and completion tracking.
Calendar-based workout history and nutrition tools.
Guided squat challenges with camera-based repetition tracking in the published app.
technicalCapabilities: iPhone app design and release for a consumer fitness product.
Editable training plans and daily workout tracking flows.
Camera-based movement tracking for the published squat challenge.
developmentChallenges: Make generated plan suggestions editable so users can review and adjust them.
Connect planning, daily workout completion, and calendar progress in one app.
Present camera-based challenge guidance in a mobile workout experience.
outcomes: A published iPhone fitness app with editable workout planning and progress tracking.
The App Store release includes AI-assisted plan generation and a guided squat challenge.
updates.seoTitle: SageSet Fitness App Case Study | Workside Software
updates.metaDescription: Workside built SageSet, a published iPhone fitness app for editable workout plans, progress tracking, nutrition tools, and guided squat challenges.
updates.imageNote: Keep /projects/sageset-challenges.webp as the genuine app screenshot. Its alt text should describe the visible challenge list.

updates.businessProblem: Field-service teams need dispatch plans, customer and job records, and technician updates to stay connected. Separate workflows can make assignments and completed field work harder to review.
updates.solution: Route Logistics connects web-based company operations with assigned technician work in a companion mobile app. Managers can schedule and assign work; technicians can review job instructions and record supported visit details. The web release is live, while the mobile apps have not received a new store release.
keyFeatures: Schedule jobs while checking staff eligibility, availability, and calendar conflicts.
Create recurring appointments and retain scheduling change history.
Provide technicians with read-only job instructions and tools for work records, photos, checklists, and visit evidence.
Allow eligible owners and managers to switch between management and their own assigned field work.
Queue supported field updates for retry when connectivity is interrupted.
technicalCapabilities: React web operations interface and Expo-based iOS and Android application source.
Firebase Authentication, Firestore, and Storage with company-scoped access checks.
Role-aware workflows, server-checked assignments, and retry-safe field updates.
developmentChallenges: Keep scheduling and field updates aligned across management and technician workflows.
Limit job instructions and actions according to company role and assignment.
Support retry of field updates through temporary connectivity interruptions.
outcomes: A production web release for dispatch, scheduling, and field-work coordination, published November 15, 2026.
The corresponding iOS and Android source is implemented; no new native store build was published with the web release.

updates.metaDescription: A production field-service web release for dispatch, recurring schedules, technician work records, and role-aware operations, with mobile source awaiting its next store release.
